scripts.check: cargo test --all && npm run check:wasm && npm run check:web && npm run test:web
scripts.check:wasm: RUSTC="$(rustup which rustc)" cargo check -p wvst-web-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.smoke:browser:web: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/web run smoke:browser
scripts.docs:dev: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run build --
scripts.docs:check: npm run build:web && npm --workspace @wvst/docs run check
